title: Internal states can be read as encoding beliefs about external states

statements.text: Given a particular partition at nonequilibrium steady state, each internal state can be paired with a probability density over external states, so internal states can be read as encoding Bayesian beliefs about what lies outside the blanket.

sources.quote: Put simply, it means that the internal states of a particular partition can be cast as encoding conditional or posterior Bayesian beliefs about external states.
